label: Paper portfolio for learning. Not investment advice.
name: AI Transition Portfolio

benchmark.name: S&P 500 (SPY total return)
benchmark.note: Alpha is the portfolio's return minus SPY's, both from the same Monday open.

themes: AI power and grid (transition-themed, not ESG-screened)

constraints.note: Shocks are the owner-approved assumptions in the planning document, not forecasts.

currencyPolicy: Developed-market positions hedged to sterling with rolling forwards; emerging-market names (TSM, EWY, EWZ, ITUB) unhedged; 15% sterling cash.

positions.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF
positions.thesis: Keeps the book from being a pure thematic bet; alpha is measured against this holding's total return.
thesisBreakers: US 10-year yield above 5.5% with a Fed hike delivered (portfolio-wide trigger, not a stock thesis)

positions.name: TSMC (ADR)
positions.thesis: Earns from every AI chip designer; Q3 revenue ran about 2% above the top of its own guidance, 2nm ramps in H2.
thesisBreakers: Gross margin guided below the 65-67% range or diluted by the 2nm ramp

positions.name: Nvidia
positions.thesis: Direct read on AI capex; held small because TSMC, Samsung and SK Hynix give the same demand without the customer concentration.
thesisBreakers: Export-control change that removes a major market
Funding failure at a top AI lab

positions.name: Alphabet
positions.thesis: A spender with its own profits and chips, balancing the supplier-heavy compute sleeve; least researched, first to cut.
thesisBreakers: Capex outruns cloud growth without a revenue response
Search share loss becomes visible in results

positions.name: iShares MSCI South Korea ETF
positions.thesis: Record memory-chip earnings (Samsung Q3 operating profit 107.4tn won) while the market sells the news; a rebound if AI worries ease.
thesisBreakers: Evidence of a memory-cycle peak: DRAM contract prices roll over
catalysts: Samsung final Q3 results late Oct (unconfirmed)

positions.name: GE Vernova
positions.thesis: Grid and gas-turbine supplier with a $176bn backlog; forward multiple has compressed while estimates rose. Target set below the Street because the multiple is the risk.
thesisBreakers: Margin miss or backlog conversion slowing at Q3
catalysts: Q3 results week of 19 Oct (day unconfirmed)

positions.name: Constellation Energy
positions.thesis: Largest US nuclear fleet; carbon-free around-the-clock power that data centres need; a lot of de-rating has already happened.

positions.name: Vistra
positions.thesis: Nuclear and gas generator with 20-year Meta supply deals and a conditional $4.2bn federal loan; sized at 6% because most of the news is priced in.
thesisBreakers: Federal loan falls through or terms are poor
2027 guidance cut below the low end of the range

positions.name: NextEra Energy
positions.thesis: Regulated Florida utility plus the largest US renewables developer; a lower-beta cushion if AI sentiment cracks. Valuation not yet checked.
thesisBreakers: US 10-year above 5.5% or a Fed hike delivered

positions.name: iShares MSCI Brazil ETF
positions.thesis: Rate-cut and fiscal-credibility re-rating after the first round; JPMorgan's 'anti-AI market' hedge inside an AI-heavy book. Reserve of 7% decides after the 25 Oct runoff.
thesisBreakers: Lula wins the runoff and the real gaps weaker
Copom does not cut in November

positions.name: Itau Unibanco (ADR)
positions.thesis: Cleanest way to own lower rates and a fiscal-credibility re-rating together; also an EWZ holding, so real exposure exceeds 3%.
thesisBreakers: Selic held at 14% longer than hoped

positions.name: SPDR Gold Shares
positions.thesis: Hedge for a geopolitical shock (Brent near $105 on the Iran conflict); weak when real yields rise, so sized at 6% and not relied on alone.
thesisBreakers: Real yields rising sharply while geopolitical risk fades

cash.name: Brazil runoff reserve (cash)
cash.role: Dry powder; deploy after 25 Oct runoff

entryPlan: Enter at Monday's open. Buy only half of TSM, NVDA and EWY then; the other half after TSMC results on Thu 15 Oct. EWZ/ITUB staged; 7% Brazil reserve decided after the 25 Oct runoff.
reserveRule: If Bolsonaro wins on 25 Oct and the real holds near 5.0, add up to 5% EWZ. If Lula wins, stay at 5% unless the review level is hit and keep the reserve in bills.

verdicts.WATCH: Something moved; named and monitored, no trade.
verdicts.ACT: A trade is proposed. Only on the conditions in actRules.

actRules: A position's review level or a drawdown step is hit

drawdownLadder.action: Review every thesis; cut GOOGL and NEE first.
Cut TSM, NVDA and EWY by a third and lift T-bills to 25%.
Move everything to cash and reset.

triggers.name: Fed hike at the 28 Oct meeting

calendar: JPMorgan, Goldman, Wells Fargo, Citi results
US September CPI; ASML Q3; BofA, Morgan Stanley, BlackRock
unverified: Current valuations for Nvidia, Alphabet and NextEra
Most earnings dates beyond TSMC's, the Fed's and the Brazil vote
Brent: two sources differ by about $20 (Alpha Vantage ~$125 on 6 Oct vs Nasdaq ~$105 weekly)
Korea Friday close, and why Constellation rose 4.6% on Friday
Sterling hedge costs and the current Bank Rate

scenarios.method: Portfolio effect (% of NAV) = sum over positions of weightPct x shock% / 100. Cash and the Brazil reserve are held at zero return. Shocks are USD price moves; sterling/FX effects and hedge costs are not modelled.

allTargets.inputs: unrounded targetUSD / refPriceUSD - 1 for each position (the targetPct field is that value rounded to 0.1)

allReviewLevels.inputs: unrounded reviewLevelUSD / refPriceUSD - 1 for each position (the reviewPct field is that value rounded to 0.1)

scenarios.note: Shock sizes are the owner-approved assumptions in the planning document, not forecasts.
